name: ebooks
description: Ebooks for every agent: read an EPUB's details, contents and text, make a valid EPUB from Markdown or HTML chapters with a cover and a table of contents, and check or repair one before it goes to Kindle, Apple Books or Kobo.

commands.name: epubcheck
commands.hint: The official EPUB checker, which stores use (it needs Java). On a Mac: brew install epubcheck. On Ubuntu or Debian: sudo apt install epubcheck. Elsewhere: download it from github.com/w3c/epubcheck/releases.

commands.name: pandoc
commands.hint: Turns Word files into ebooks. On a Mac: brew install pandoc. On Ubuntu or Debian: sudo apt install pandoc. On Windows: winget install pandoc.
